datenschutz.intro: Privacy policy in accordance with GDPR and German BDSG.

sections.p:
The controller responsible for data processing on this website is:
Freie Evangeliums-Christen-Gemeinde Dresden e.V., Altenberger Strasse 87, 01279 Dresden, Deutschland.
E-mail: info@fecg-dresden.de · Phone: +49 351 253 04 03

We process personal data only insofar as it is necessary to provide a functional website. The legal basis is regularly your consent (Art. 6 (1) (a) GDPR) or a statutory permission (Art. 6 (1) (b), (c), (f) GDPR).

The hosting provider automatically collects information in server log files (browser type, OS, referrer, hostname, time, IP address). This data is not merged with other sources. Legal basis: Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR.

Non-essential cookies are only set with your explicit consent through our consent banner (Art. 6 (1) (a) GDPR, § 25 (1) TDDDG). Technically necessary cookies (language, consent storage) are used pursuant to § 25 (2) no. 2 TDDDG. You can withdraw your consent at any time with effect for the future.
If you contact us, the data you provide will be stored to process your request. Legal basis: Art. 6 (1) (b) or (f) GDPR. No data is passed on to third parties.
Our "Find Us" page embeds maps from OpenStreetMap (OSMF, Cambridge, UK). When you load the page, technical data (incl. IP address) is transmitted to OSMF. Legal basis: Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR.
We use Bunny Fonts (EU provider) as a privacy-friendly alternative to Google Fonts. No user profiling takes place.

You have the right of access (Art. 15), rectification (Art. 16), erasure (Art. 17), restriction (Art. 18), data portability (Art. 20) and objection (Art. 21), as well as the right to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority (Saxon Data Protection Commissioner), Devrientstraße 1, 01067 Dresden.
You have the right, on grounds relating to your particular situation, to object at any time to the processing of personal data concerning you.
For security reasons this site uses SSL/TLS encryption.
We reserve the right to amend this declaration to ensure it always meets current legal requirements.
